title: The Most Honest Job Interview Ever 💼
description:
This story may be inspired by real events or jokes, but all names and details are fictional. Any resemblance to real people is coincidental.

#funny #storytime #interview #shorts
style: 3D animated cartoon movie style, expressive characters with big eyes, vibrant colours, cinematic lighting, vertical composition, highly detailed, no text, no letters, no watermark

scenes.text: I walked into my job interview with zero preparation and full confidence.
scenes.image: a confident young woman about 26 with a ponytail and a blazer walking into an office confidently, coffee in hand

scenes.text: The manager looked at my resume and asked, what's your greatest strength?
scenes.image: a serious hiring manager about 50 in a suit behind a desk reading a resume and asking a question

scenes.text: I said, I'm very honest. He wrote it down and nodded.
scenes.image: a confident young woman about 26 with a ponytail and a blazer smiling confidently, a serious hiring manager about 50 in a suit behind a desk taking notes

scenes.text: Then he asked, okay, and what's your biggest weakness?
scenes.image: a serious hiring manager about 50 in a suit behind a desk leaning forward with a tricky expression
a confident young woman about 26 with a ponytail and a blazer shrugging casually

scenes.text: He frowned and said, I don't think honesty is a weakness.
scenes.image: a serious hiring manager about 50 in a suit behind a desk frowning and putting down his pen

scenes.text: I looked him in the eyes and said, I don't really care what you think.
scenes.image: a confident young woman about 26 with a ponytail and a blazer leaning back with arms crossed, completely calm, a serious hiring manager about 50 in a suit behind a desk shocked

scenes.text: He stared at me for ten seconds. Then he said, when can you start? Apparently, every other candidate lied.
scenes.image: a serious hiring manager about 50 in a suit behind a desk laughing and shaking hands with a confident young woman about 26 with a ponytail and a blazer, a pile of rejected resumes in the bin
